title: Sources: a16z is in talks to raise ~$20B across its next set of funds; its last set, announced in January at $15B+, later grew to $20B+ with three add-ons (Lucinda Shen/Axios)
summary: Lucinda Shen / Axios: Sources: a16z is in talks to raise ~$20B across its next set of funds; its last set, announced in January at $15B+, later grew to $20B+ with three add-ons — Venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz is in talks to raise about $20 billion across its next set of funds, Axios Pro has learned from three sources familiar.
